messages:
sara (CSM): Quick ask from VerdantAI ops: launching a 72h marketing push in AP-South-2. They need a temporary QPS increase + a header-based allowlist for their payment partner (payflow.partner.co). Can we scope this to region and auto-revoke after the window?
leo (SRE): Numbers? and what header do they send?
sara (CSM): They want 4x baseline QPS, with a hard cap of 600 RPS, start 2026-05-10 02:00 UTC for 72h. Header is `X-Partner-Signature` and should only be accepted when Host matches `payflow.partner.co`. They also mentioned partner IP ranges but asked header check for extra safety.
marta (Support): Account note: VerdantAI on Standard plan, renewal sync in ~5 weeks. No open incidents. This is high-impact for their go-live; recommend we make it simple to avoid friction.
toni (AE): I'll ask for PO or a one-time billing agreement. They asked for a goodwill credit but we should confirm.
leo (SRE): Technically doable. Plan: add a customer-scoped ingress policy in ap-south-2 that matches header+host and IP CIDR list, then apply qps_override. Suggest: qps_override: 600, burst_limit: 900, expires_at: 2026-05-13T02:00:00Z. Need CR and 1h maintenance window for config rollout.
ops-bot: @leo filed change CR-3141 for verdantai header allowlist + qps override. Review ETA 90m.
sara (CSM): Can we make fallback behavior explicit? If requests come from other regions or missing header, they should get normal quota and 429s. Customer explicitly requested no cross-region spillover.
leo (SRE): Yes. Routing rule: if region==ap-south-2 AND header X-Partner-Signature matches payflow.partner.co AND source_ip in allowed_cidrs then apply override; else default quotas. We'll add a soft-429 threshold to trigger alerting.
marta (Support): I'll prepare the customer note with expected start/end, example request, dashboard link, and a single on-call contact for quick rollback. Example curl for ops:

curl -H "X-Partner-Signature: <sig>" -H "Host: payflow.partner.co" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"..."}'

Include monitoring: https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/clients/verdantai/throughput
toni (AE): Told customer we'll keep overages on standard terms unless we agree a credit. They asked for a small promo credit; I have them confirming via email.
leo (SRE): Internal config snippet (for ops):

- customer: verdantai
  region: ap-south-2
  header_allowlist:
    name: X-Partner-Signature
    host_match: payflow.partner.co
  ip_allowlist:
    - 203.0.113.0/24
    - 198.51.100.128/25
  qps_override: 600
  burst_limit: 900
  expires_at: 2026-05-13T02:00:00Z
  revoke_policy: auto

leo (SRE): Rollout plan: staging smoke tonight, prod apply 15m before start, canary 5% nodes for 10m then full. Rollback: remove rule and flush routing cache.
marta (Support): ops-bot, please tag CR-3141 with `auto-revoke` and schedule a reminder 1h before expiry.
ops-bot: Tagging CR-3141 with auto-revoke; reminder scheduled at 2026-05-13T01:00:00Z.
sara (CSM): Great. Once toni confirms billing, we'll greenlight. This one likely moves renewal needle so I'll log the outcome in the account health doc after the promo. :sparkles:
